secureTunnelDesc: Import your configuration to establish a secure connection. Paste your subscription link below to get started.
vpnModeDesc: All system traffic routed through tunnel
systemProxyModeDesc: Sets system-wide proxy for all apps
noServersDesc: Add a subscription to get started.
noProfilesDesc: Add your first subscription or config to get started.
systemConfigDesc: Fine-tune routing, node filtering, and core system behaviors.
launchOnBootDesc: Silent start in system tray at OS launch.
checkForUpdatesDesc: Ensure you are running the latest version.
autoUpdateIntervalDesc: Background profile servers update frequency (in minutes)
smartNodeDesc: Automatically switch to the lowest latency node periodically.
localityBypassDesc: Local government and banking sites are routed outside the tunnel for performance.
killSwitchDesc: Block all internet traffic if the VPN connection drops unexpectedly.
allowLanDesc: Maintain access to local network devices (printers, shares) while connected.
customDnsDesc: Use secure Custom DNS over HTTPS to prevent ISP DNS leaks.
geoNodeRulesDesc: Control country specific routing. Adding a country to one list disables it in the other.
protocolRulesDesc: Control which connection protocols are allowed or blocked.
aboutDesc: Important legal information and application details.
disclaimerText: You are using third-party proxy servers at your own risk. The developer of this application assumes no responsibility for any data leaks, privacy breaches, or service unavailabilities. Ensure your actions comply with your local legislation.
updateInstalled: Update installed. Please restart the application.
connectionFailedDesc: Check your configuration and try again
addFailed: Failed to add subscription. Check the URL and try again.
logsDesc: System events and connection log stream.
antiDpiDesc: Randomizes TLS fingerprint to bypass deep packet inspection.
enableMuxDesc: Multiplex multiple TCP streams over a single connection for lower overhead.
minimizeToTrayDesc: Minimize app to system tray instead of closing.
blockCdnNodesDesc: Hide Cloudflare Workers and WARP nodes whose exit IP changes constantly.
ipinfoTokenDesc: Free token from ipinfo.io — enables ipinfo_lite.mmdb for improved GeoIP and ASN coverage alongside MaxMind GeoLite2.
